info.name: KHR_RENDERER_BACKGROUND_IMAGE
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension; element types are identical, the description documents this device's semantics: the image is composited under the (transparent-film) render by the output driver, so it is exact per pixel, honors the image's alpha, and is never visible in reflections/refractions (matching the color background, which camera rays alone see).

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: background image, bilinearly stretched over the frame in screen space; camera rays that miss all geometry write the sampled color and alpha into channel.color (alpha = coverage + (1-coverage)*image.a; sRGB element types are linearized); a camera-visible HDRI light overrides the background entirely
